title: ProjectListCommand
responsibility: Registers a local project list command and writes the Harness reader’s aggregate result to stdout.

inputs.name: ProjectListCommand.register.program
inputs.description: The root Harness command to extend.

outputs.name: ProjectListCommand.register
outputs.description: Adds the projects list command to the root program.

outputs.name: ProjectListCommand.run
outputs.description: Writes the projected list or the current empty or unavailable state.
